Action Chiropractic and Sports Injury Center provides sports chiropractic care in Naperville, IL, helping athletes and active adults get out of pain, move better, and Get Back to Action.

We treat back pain, neck pain, sports injuries, muscle and joint pain, mobility issues, and overuse injuries using advanced, hands-on treatment techniques including:

• Chiropractic care
• Active Release Techniques (ART)
• Shockwave Therapy (ESWT)
• Dry needling
• Instrument-Assisted Soft Tissue Mobilization (IASTM)
• Cupping therapy
• Cold laser therapy
• Corrective exercise & rehabilitation
• Sports injury treatment & recovery

Individualized, results-focused care designed to help you recover, move, and perform at your best.
